prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: one complete full-body rigid 2D Spine attack_peak production attachment for a side-view combat game.

Input images: Image 1 is authoritative only for the current three-quarter combat camera, screen-right facing direction, costume appearance, apparent character scale, pixel density, and the exact 1680-by-2512 canvas coordinate family. Do not copy its idle posture or any illumination outside the physical silhouette. Image 2 is authoritative for Vivhite's original magical-girl costume construction, blue butterfly ornament, body design, and color placement. Image 3 is authoritative for her facial identity, short layered silver-white bob, vivid violet-pink eyes, and thin round gold glasses.

Primary request: Draw exactly one Vivhite at the single impact instant of a fast, forceful, empty-handed magical palm strike toward screen-right. This is a newly drawn action peak, not a deformed idle pose. Lower her pelvis decisively, bend both knees, keep the screen-left rear boot planted and driving, place the screen-right front boot forward and grounded, rotate the hips toward screen-right, twist the shoulders farther than the hips, and lean the torso forward on a strong diagonal. Her screen-right near arm drives almost straight toward the enemy with an open empty palm at upper-chest height; make that palm clean, readable, and unobstructed as the later runtime VFX origin. Pull the far elbow back beside the ribs with its empty hand open for counterbalance. Her eyes lock toward screen-right. Hair tips, butterfly, and skirt panels trail subtly toward screen-left from the acceleration while remaining attached and anatomically coherent. The silhouette must read as impact even with no effect layer.

Composition and scale contract: Preserve Image 1's head size, body proportions, and pixel density; do not enlarge, shrink, normalize, or recenter the character to fill the canvas. Keep the full butterfly, hair, both hands and every finger, skirt, both bent knees, and both boot soles inside the same canvas. Keep the two boot contacts near their Image 1 perspective baselines. Use these approximate layout targets on the 1680-by-2512 canvas: pelvis near (780,1260), head center near (900,390), eye midpoint near (960,470), screen-left rear boot contact near (486,2181), screen-right front boot contact near (1197,2475), and striking-palm center near (1510,700). These are pose anchors, not marks or labels. Leave clean unused padding at every edge.

Style and lighting: polished 2D anime game-sprite painting, crisp controlled contours, restrained interior cel shading, matte non-emissive costume surfaces, consistent detail and camera with Image 1. Every highlight and shadow stops at the physical character contour.

Constraints: one continuous figure, one pose, one view. Empty hands only. No sword, blade, staff, wand, rod, spear, spellbook, shield, orb, weapon-shaped prop, or held object. No magic arc, sigil, spell projectile, aura, outer glow, bloom, rim light, detached illumination, haze, smoke, or particles; those are separate runtime VFX. No floor, cast shadow, scenery, frame, text, logo, signature, or watermark. No sprite sheet, character sheet, turnaround, panel grid, duplicate pose, extra person, extra limb, missing limb, fused fingers, broken wrist, cropped hair, cropped butterfly, cropped fingers, or cropped boots. Do not draw an upright idle stance, a swordsman stance, a frontal camera, or a weak raised-hand gesture.
